title: Ukraine Drone Strike Destroys 2,700 Nvidia GPUs at Yandex Data Center
summary:
Outages across Russia's most dominant internet provider surged Thursday following a fire that crippled a critical computing hub in Sasovo. The 35+ MW facility, one of the largest in the country, reportedly housed nearly 2,700 Nvidia A100 GPUs imported before sanctions locked down the nation's tech sector. Ukrainian drones struck the site on Wednesday night, which is colocated with the Sasta machine-tool plant, a manufacturer supplying equipment to Russia's defense industry.

Yandex engineering reported power failures in the ru-central1-b zone, affecting search, map, and taxi services. The aerial campaign also targeted the Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat refinery in Bashkortostan and follows a series of Russian strikes on Ukrainian data centers. The loss of the pre-sanction GPU clusters limits the tech giant's capacity to train large-scale AI models.

selectedTweets.text:
Ukrainian drones struck a Yandex data center in Sasovo, Russia’s Ryazan Oblast, and the Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat oil refinery in Bashkortostan overnight, sparking fires.

In Sasovo, the attack damaged one of Yandex’s largest data centers, causing power outages and widespread disruptions to its cloud services.

The strike followed a series of Russian attacks on Ukrainian data centers.

A fire also broke out at the Sasta machine-tool plant, which shares the site with the data center and supplies Russia’s defense industry.
